image_description: A vintage-style comic book cover featuring a group of four characters in red and black costumes looking upwards. Above them is a large yellow explosion cloud with red text, and a flying character in a white suit. The top features a bold, stylized title logo. There are speech bubbles and caption boxes visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface appears to have the sheen of glossy paper, features colorful illustrations, and has a prominent title at the top.

The spine/left edge is partially visible but the resolution and angle do not allow for clear identification of staple marks; they are likely too small to resolve or are occluded by the angle/lighting.

artifact_observations.location: Top title logo and yellow explosion text
artifact_observations.reasoning: The main title at the top is stylized but largely illegible/nonsensical. The text inside the yellow explosion is completely garbled pseudo-text, failing to form readable words, which is a common AI artifact in text-heavy genres.
The flying figure in the upper right has indistinct limb connections; the legs/cape blend into each other without clear anatomical separation or logical flow.
The facial features are slightly smeared and lack the crisp line work expected of professional comic inking, appearing somewhat 'muddy' or low-resolution compared to the rest of the image.
